verses.english: “There are, mendicants, these two kinds of growth.
Growth in things of the flesh and growth in the teaching.
These are the two kinds of growth.

verses.pali: Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, imāsaṁ dvinnaṁ vuddhīnaṁ yadidaṁ dhammavuddhī”ti.
verses.english: The better of these two kinds of growth is growth in the teaching.”
